summary: Completed testing of two bug fixes: 1) Avatar upload with main_site_users fallback (DBNT site support), 2) Image resize dialog PNG->JPEG conversion. All 7 backend API tests pass. All 3 frontend pages load without errors.

test_results.avatar_upload_with_main_site_header: PASS - POST /api/users/{user_id}/avatar with X-Main-Site-ID finds user via main_site_users fallback
test_results.avatar_upload_without_main_site_header: PASS - Falls back to team_id lookup when no header present
test_results.avatar_delete_with_main_site_header: PASS - DELETE /api/users/{user_id}/avatar works for site-specific users
test_results.avatar_upload_validates_file_type: PASS - Invalid file types rejected with 400
test_results.media_library_page_loads: PASS - /radiogroep/media loads with 5 media items visible
test_results.show_management_page_loads: PASS - /radiogroep/show-management loads with Show Titles (10) and Studios (5)

avatar_dbnt_fix.description: Avatar upload/delete now works on DBNT and other main sites
avatar_dbnt_fix.root_cause: require_admin checked global role only, user lookup by team_id only found users in admin's team
avatar_dbnt_fix.fix: Use get_effective_role for site-specific admin check, fall back to main_site_users lookup when team_id lookup fails

image_resize_png_fix.description: Image resize dialog now converts PNG to JPEG for proper compression
image_resize_png_fix.root_cause: PNG files were kept as PNG (lossless format - quality param has no effect)
image_resize_png_fix.fix: Always convert to JPEG for compression, outputType hardcoded to 'image/jpeg'
image_resize_png_fix.status: CODE VERIFIED - Client-side only, harder to test in automated tests

critical_code_review_comments: Avatar upload/delete now uses get_effective_role() instead of require_admin for flexible role checking
main_site_users fallback lookup allows finding users across different teams when X-Main-Site-ID is provided
imageResize.js now always outputs JPEG format with progressive quality reduction (0.85 -> 0.30)
White background added for transparent PNG to JPEG conversion
seed_data_creation: Test JPEG image created programmatically using PIL (100x100 red square)
